Age of Fracture.how: Mend the Elden Ring as Elden Lord with no other choice taken.

Age of the Duskborn.how: Complete Fia's questline and use the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.

Age of Order.how: Complete Goldmask's questline and use the Mending Rune of Perfect Order.

Lord of the Frenzied Flame.how: Accept the Three Fingers, then choose it at the end.

Age of Stars.how: Complete Ranni's questline and summon her at the end.
